two_player.mode: same-process listen server and client PIE, rendered

visual_review.scope: Owned world-weapon duplication and visibility restoration only
visual_review.method: All 240 frames reviewed in five contact sheets; six critical frames and eight lifecycle stills inspected at full size
findings: No second owned world weapon appears in first-person low-look, crouch, aim or swap frames
Third-person switch removes the dedicated view weapon; returning restores one view weapon
Drop and weapon destruction remove the dedicated view weapon; pickup and respawn equip restore one
Remote body remains visible; both remote world weapons retain their normal render flags in every sampled frame
separate_observations: In repossess.png the first-person arms and gun appear at the top of the screen. Visibility counts pass, but this frame is not accepted as proof of correct animation or camera fitting. Cause not diagnosed in this visibility fix.
HUD crosshair is offset in HighResShot output; this capture is not a HUD alignment validation.

limitations: No independent-process latency or packet-loss test
Peer damage disabled during action checks, enabled for deliberate death test
AK47 visibility regression only; existing animation fitting unchanged
30 fps video reconstructed from each fixed simulation frame, not a wall-clock performance capture
